claim: At Legendary Play, a mobile game company that builds on Amazon EventBridge, a blockchain service consumes all the events in the system to update the chain, and each service exists in its own AWS account (customer case study).
question: How does Legendary Play use events in its EventBridge-based game platform (AWS case study)?

values.display: consumes all the events in the system
each of its services exists on its own AWS account

evidence.quote: On top of all that, Legendary Play has a blockchain service that consumes all the events in the system to update the chain.
Legendary Play uses a multiaccount strategy, meaning each of its services exists on its own AWS account within the organization.

note: d107. The page title is 'Uniting Blockchain and Esports Using Amazon EventBridge with Legendary Play'.
